ClawTK 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Automates OpenClaw API cost reductions by 60-80% through one-command setup.
- Provides spend cap enforcement, config optimization, retry-loop protection, and token compression.
- Simple commands enable setup, status checks, cost savings reports, config restoration, and syncing.
- Includes Pro activation, cloud sync features, and clear guidance to protect against overspending.
